text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: This year's summer training camp is quite different from last year's. The reason being—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Admire Groove doesn't have that brooding intensity she had last year.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Well then, I'll go put my bags down.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Understood.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Strengthening myself... is naturally something I must do.
However, right now—"

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna lay my futon right here!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Ehh, isn't taking the edge kinda unfair?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Hey now, no fighting at the training camp.
Let's get along, get along... okay?"

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Ah, Cesario-san!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Okaaay, got it~

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Fufu, good girls, all of you.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
What's wrong?! If you're giving up at this level,
you won't stand a chance in the real race.

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Eeeh, and you were so nice earlier, too~.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Switch your mindset back into gear! Everyone, get hydrated and regroup!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Cesario-san can be kind at times,
and strict at others. She really gives off that
quintessential "senpai...!" aura, doesn't she?

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Totally~.
Like, you just wanna follow her everywhere.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (Sometimes gentle, sometimes strict... huh.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (...A senior who is looked up to and trusted by her juniors...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (Sometimes strict...)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Senpai, is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Duramente-san...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Don't be soft.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...?
Yes... Understood.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Something feels off.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (In the end, I couldn't even be nice properly... What should I do...?)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Alv-san?
Is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Cesario-san.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
“—I see.
So you were thinking about how to interact with your juniors.”

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Still... it's never that easy, is it?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
I don't know the ropes.
I've never looked after an underclassman before.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I can't do it like you do.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: It's not as though you need to imitate me, you know.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
There's no guarantee that the junior you speak of
would be compatible with an approach like mine.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: "If they admire the person you are right now, isn't it fine not to force a change?"

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I wonder if that's just how things are.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
Besides, this is just my nature.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
In terms of instruction,
as long as there's a clear sense of balance and rhythm, there shouldn't be a problem.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Give praise when praise is due.
Correct mistakes when corrections are needed.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
After that, I believe it's fine to leave
the exact measure up to you, Alv-san.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: My own... fine-tuning...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Even the senior you look up to
surely isn't the same as me.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (I see. So that person was...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(Always strict and nagging.
Even so, I...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(There must surely be
a way to pass the torch that is uniquely "ours"...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you.
The fog in my mind has cleared.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
――Alright. The sand by the beach might
catch my footing, but how should I run...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Alv-senpai...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: —300m, 3 reps.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"If it's you, that ought to be plenty.
—Come at me."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
—Thank you very much.
I will master it within the allotted time, without fail.

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
Haaaaaaah!
Daaaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The mentor-apprentice bond between Umamusume takes many shapes, each with its own compatibility.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Admire Groove and Duramente. Even with few words exchanged, a shared philosophy flows between the two.
